fixes.explanation: True, baker! He answers the question Himself: "It is I, proclaiming vindication, mighty to save." (Isaiah 63:1). He doesn't give a name here. He tells you what He does.

Good thinking, friend. A threshing floor is a place of hard work, but this verse is about something else. The garments are "…like one who treads the winepress?" (Isaiah 63:2). So the answer is the winepress.
That's right, baker. He says, "I looked, but there was no one to help…" and then, "So My arm brought Me salvation…" (Isaiah 63:5). No one helped Him. His own arm did the work.
